name: Bench Dips on Swiss Ball with Weighted Vest
description: Bench dips with feet on a Swiss ball while wearing a weighted vest for maximum difficulty. The vest distributes weight evenly while the ball adds instability, demanding substantial tricep strength and core control. This is an advanced progression of standard bench dips.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Bench Dips on Swiss Ball with Weighted Vest in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Bench Dips on Swiss Ball with Weighted Vest.
steps: Step 1: Wear weighted vest. Set hands on bench, feet on Swiss ball.
Step 2: Slide hips off bench maintaining balance on ball.
Step 3: Lower body by bending elbows to full depth.
Step 4: Press back to full extension, stabilizing ball with legs.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Control ball with isometric leg tension
